meta.task: InsureDAO L2 Phase-2 source-diff & exploitability audit (v2 corrected)
meta.correction_note: v1 falsely listed CDSTemplate.compensate and PoolTemplate.registerIndex as fresh-attacker E-U paths. Reachability re-analysis showed neither is callable by an unprivileged actor; both are owner-gated in practice. This file is the corrected v2.

blob_matches.description: deployed verified source files are byte-identical git blobs in pool-contracts@3327626

onchain_factory_config.implication: Only PoolTemplate clones can be created by third parties; they are plain insurance pools with no arbitrary-call capability.

reachability_analysis.key_insight: A Factory clone of an approved template is the only listed contract a fresh attacker can create. PoolTemplate clones expose no generic/arbitrary external call; all outbound calls use fixed selectors to storage-set addresses or to indexList entries. indexList is only writable via registerIndex(), which registers sender and requires sender to be a listed market; the only code path that calls registerIndex is IndexTemplate.set() (onlyOwner). Therefore the credit/compensation graph is owner-gated in practice.
owner_gated_functions: PoolTemplate.allocateCredit / withdrawCredit (require indices[msg.sender].exist, set only by registerIndex)

onchain_confirmation.cdn_compensated_events: none (CDS clone 0x86c82 has only deposit/withdraw/approval/transfer logs)
onchain_confirmation.registry_getCDS: 0x0 for all indices and the global slot

selector_checks.method: cast code + dispatcher extraction (PUSH4 and PUSH3/PUSH2 leading-zero optimization) vs verified ABI

findings.title: REJECTED CANDIDATE: CDSTemplate.compensate() is isListed-gated but not reachable by an unprivileged actor

evidence.only_callers: IndexTemplate.compensate (impl_2b16/IndexTemplate.sol:452), which requires allocPoints[msg.sender] != 0 set by IndexTemplate.set (onlyOwner, lines 602-640)
why_not_exploitable: A fresh attacker's only creatable listed contract is a PoolTemplate clone (only open template).
PoolTemplate clones contain no generic external call; their only calls are fixed-selector calls to vault/registry/parameters and to indexList entries.

indexList can only be written by registerIndex, which requires the caller to be a listed market and to call it itself; the only protocol code that calls registerIndex is the owner-gated IndexTemplate.set.
Thus an attacker cannot place themselves (or a helper contract) into any pool's indexList or any index's poolList, and cannot originate CDS.compensate.
On-chain: no Compensated event was ever emitted; registry.getCDS returns 0x0 for all indices; CDS crowdPool 59,793,841,027 intact.

evidence.why_not_exploitable: registerIndex registers msg.sender; EOAs fail isListed, and no protocol code lets a third-party contract call registerIndex on another pool. Only IndexTemplate.set (onlyOwner) calls it. Audited version was actually more permissive (any listed market could allocateCredit directly).

findings.title: H-06 rounding issue persists but is not profitable for a fresh attacker
findings.eu: no (requires a future victim depositor; new pools cannot be seeded tiny because conditionlist[0]=1e9 forces >=1000 USDC initial deposit; existing tiny-supply value would accrue to legacy holders, not the attacker)

findings.title: Privileged-role risks (unchanged, acknowledged by sponsor/C4)
findings.detail: PoolProxy admins 0x54bE2f27E95BdAA5104960aAE7816554C0e3F056 (ownership/parameter/emergency) can list arbitrary templates/markets (H-07/H-10), set controller/keeper, call defund/withdrawRedundant/applyBounty, etc. default_reporting_admin is 0x0 today, so applyCover/applyBounty are frozen.

findings.title: Minor griefing/DoS edges (no profit)
findings.detail: anyone can unlock expired policies (blocks later past-period cover redemption for that policy); Vault._divRoundUp makes very small withdrawals revert when price/attribution > 1; PoolProxy.withdraw_admin_fee reverts if total_weights==0 or n_distributors==0; resume() reverts if an owner-registered index lacks adjustAlloc/compensate.

mint_paths.note: emergency_minted += amount before _mint; schedule cap bypassed for emergency mints

advances emission epoch only; no mint

insure_token_analysis.verdict: No unprivileged path mints INSURE to an attacker without staking in a registered LiquidityGauge; emissions go to the staker/approved beneficiary. Emergency mint dead (module=0x0). Value target ~$0.

itoken_base_analysis.verdict: no public mint/burn or transfer-hook issues

pool_proxy_analysis.role: pool owner (parameters.getOwner()) and Vault ownership; holds pooled admin fee attributions
pool_proxy_analysis.note: permissionless triggers route PoolProxy-owned fee attributions to configured distributors; callers gain nothing. pool_apply_cover/pool_apply_bounty are reporting-admin gated and currently frozen (default_reporting_admin=0x0).
